response.evidence: Among Asian female applicants, the large majority of loan applications resulted in 'Loan originated' (approved), with only a small minority denied. The approval rates for Asian females are high and comparable to or better than other demographic groups when controlling for key factors (loan amount, debt-to-income, loan-to-value, etc.). There is no statistical evidence in this dataset indicating systemic discrimination against Asian females in the loan approval process.

Asian females (derived_race='Asian', derived_sex='Female') are frequently granted loans. Most loan applications from Asian females are approved, with only a very small proportion denied. There is no statistical evidence in the data for higher denial rates or worse outcomes for Asian females compared to other groups.

Asian females appear throughout the dataset both among approved ('Loan originated') and denied ('Application denied') applicants. A quantitative scan shows the overwhelming majority of Asian females—across all income, age, and risk (debt-to-income (DTI), loan-to-value (LTV)) segments—were approved. Where Asian females were denied, cases were concentrated among applicants with very high DTI/LTV or otherwise adverse risk factors; similar denials are present for other races/genders. There is no pattern of disproportionate denial for Asian females relative to others with similar profiles.

The approval rate for Asian females is similar to or higher than for other groups in the data. There are many Asian female applicants and the vast majority of their applications are approved, indicating no statistical evidence of systemic discrimination against this group in the loan approval process within the data provided.

Analysis of the data shows that Asian females received a substantial number of loan originations (approvals) with only a small number of application denials. The approval rate for Asian females is consistent with or higher than comparable groups, adjusted for similar financial metrics. There is no statistical evidence of systematic discrimination against Asian females in the loan approval process within this dataset.
